description: R1-frontier: Claude Opus 5.5 on the R1 balanced_03 panel (50 mazes) plus the R1-era S4/D3 pair (52 tasks), the R1 fixed cell verbatim (minimal/image_only/text_summary_and_last3+stateless/zero_shot/egocentric, step_by_step, progress_stall_k=30). Same harness as the GPT-6 Astra run (branch exp/astra-harness-probes lineage, DROP in the action list). Model settings mirror R1's Claude Opus 4.8 entry: effort=xhigh, 64k cap, Message Batches API through the lockstep worker (API_WORKER_ROLE=lockstep-worker).
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_model_params: Opus 5.5 rejects sampling params (never sent) and cannot disable thinking; enable_thinking=true sends adaptive thinking with display=summarized so thinking summaries are logged, and effort=xhigh is set explicitly (the Opus 5.5 API default is medium). max_tokens 64000 = R1's Claude cap and Astra's max_completion_tokens. Batch pricing ($2 in / $10 out per 1M, 50% of $4/$20). max_in_flight=64 >= lockstep working set (API_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=52). The coordinator must serve with STALE_AFTER_SECONDS >= batch_deadline_s + cancel grace + low-credit wait (7200+300+3600 -> 12600).
